title: Paris law
description: Documented public fatigue crack law (Paris & Erdogan (1963)) for the Material Failure Forecaster capability area.
body:
Paris law is a documented fatigue crack law from Paris & Erdogan (1963). The power law relating fatigue crack growth rate to stress-intensity range — the foundation of damage-tolerant design and remaining-life prediction.

How it works: It works by applying the Basquin power law to the stress level, returning the predicted cycles to fatigue failure.

Documented uses of this capability area include alloy design for aerospace, metamaterial antennas and cloaks, composite airframes, and failure-life prediction for critical structures.
